name: Dysfunctional Systems Episode 1: Learning to Manage Chaos
source: Dysfunctional Systems is an episodic visual novel chronicling the life of Winter Harrison. Having long become comfortable with her utopian society, Winter is surprised to learn that there are other worlds in other planes of existence. These worlds are quite different from hers, ranging from troubled, to dystopian, to futuristic or fantastical. However, they are all riddled with problems that, if not resolved, may adversely affect her home world. She is chosen to become a "mediator", charged with the maintenance of order in these chaotic planes, and so enters a vocational school for training. Episode 1 details her second shadowing of a seasoned mediator, only a few weeks into her first year. She and her mentor enter a world seemingly much like their own, except for this issue of "poverty" with which Winter has difficulty understanding...
translation: 《功能失调系统》是一部讲述温特·哈里森生活的情景视觉小说。温特早已适应了她的乌托邦社会，她惊讶地发现在其他存在层面上还有其他世界。这些世界与她的世界截然不同，从混乱的世界到反乌托邦的世界，到未来的世界或幻想的世界。然而，它们都充满了问题，如果不解决，可能会对她的家乡产生不利影响。她被选为“调停者”，负责维持混乱位面的秩序，因此进入职业学校接受训练。第一集详细介绍了她第二次跟踪一位经验丰富的调解员，当时她刚进入第一年仅几周。她和她的导师进入了一个看似与他们自己的世界很相似的世界，除了这个让温特难以理解的“贫困”问题……
